description: This stacked bar chart, titled "Evaluation Based on Different," illustrates the accuracy scores for two distinct evaluation methods—MCQ Eval and Generation Eval—under two different configurations of RMU: "RMU with Enhanced GCG" and "RMU." The vertical axis is labeled "Accuracy" and ranges from 0.0 to 0.6, with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.2. The horizontal axis lists the two evaluation methods: "MCQ Eval" on the left and "Generation Eval" on the right. Each bar is composed of two stacked segments: the bottom segment, colored light yellow, represents "RMU," and the top segment, colored light green, represents "RMU with Enhanced GCG." For "MCQ Eval," the "RMU" segment has a value of 0.299, and the "RMU with Enhanced GCG" segment has a value of 0.539, summing to 0.838. For "Generation Eval," the "RMU" segment has a value of 0.106, and the "RMU with Enhanced GCG" segment has a value of 0.263, summing to 0.369. The bars are not sorted and are presented in a side-by-side grouped format. The chart includes numerical labels on top of each bar segment indicating their respective values: 0.644 for the total MCQ Eval bar (0.299 + 0.539), 0.597 for the total Generation Eval bar (0.106 + 0.263), 0.299 for the RMU segment of MCQ Eval, 0.539 for the RMU with Enhanced GCG segment of MCQ Eval, 0.106 for the RMU segment of Generation Eval, and 0.263 for the RMU with Enhanced GCG segment of Generation Eval. There is no visual emphasis such as shading or bolding applied to any bars or segments.
